diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on :resource.aws_launch_template.ng, but this dependency is already established implicitly through the launch_template_specification references (aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and .latest_version) in the mixed_instances_policy block.

:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on :resource.aws_iam_role.ng, but the role dependency is already established transitively via aws_launch_template.ng -> aws_iam_instance_profile.ng -> aws_iam_role.ng, and via the role policy attachments (eks-ng, eks-cni, ecr-read) also present in the same depends_on list.
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on :resource.aws_iam_role.ng, but this is already an implicit dependency via the node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn attribute reference.

:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate has an explicit depends_on on :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate, but this is already an implicit dependency via the pod_execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn attribute reference.
